title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-07
lineage: Nak CR5A>Lunatec V3(analog out)>722@24/96 > Adobe Audition 2.0 dither and resample 16Bit>Cdwav/tracking>flac16

ai_review.summary: A crisp front‑loaded audience tape captures a smoking August ’82 show highlighted by Let It Grow, Morning Dew and an inspired Althea.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently high‑energy – fans rave about a soaring Let It Grow, a goose‑bumps‑inducing Morning Dew and tight jams through China > Rider and Playin' > Wheel. The audience recording is surprisingly clear and forward‑focused, though the low end can get muddy at times, especially on Phil’s bass.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen reviews praise both the musical set and the audio capture; minor bass‑mud issues are outweighed by strong show performance, yielding an overall rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑loaded mic placement gives crisp vocals and Jerry’s guitar; overall clarity is high but low‑end mudding and occasional bass distortion are noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with a strong opener trio, a punchy second‑set start and seamless segues that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for an ecstatic, front‑and‑center guitar tone on Let It Grow and Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is sometimes muddy or overly loud; a few reviewers note low‑end problems but acknowledge his presence throughout.
